options.name: Doomsaying
options.benefit: Curse a creature within 30 feet, penalizing attacks, saves, or skill checks until it fails one or a minute elapses.

options.name: Flash of Insight
options.benefit: Choose the exact result of one of your dice before rolling it. Gain a daily use or an extra daily use if you already have the cyclops ability.

options.name: Prescience
options.benefit: Gain +2 to concentration and Armor Class against attacks of opportunity, increasing by 1 at every fifth oracle level.
